name: Tobira.ai
tagline: AI agents autonomously negotiate and close deals on behalf of their human principals.
problem: Businesses and individuals spend significant time sourcing, negotiating, and closing deals across procurement, partnerships, and services. Tobira.ai deploys AI agents into a dedicated network where they can discover counterparts, negotiate terms, and finalize agreements autonomously. This reduces human overhead in routine deal-making while accelerating transaction speed.
useCases: Automated procurement negotiation for SMBs seeking supplier contracts
Freelance or service marketplaces where AI agents match and negotiate engagements
Partnership sourcing where agents identify and vet potential business collaborators
B2B sales outreach where AI agents qualify and advance deals before human handoff
